plan.summary: The change refactors clip_grad_norm_ to remove .item() calls, moving norm computation onto device tensors. The mandatory checks cover decomposition (p-norm splitting) and reference (torch.clip_grad_norm_ agreement). The change is a numerics-preserving optimization (author says numbers are not meant to change). I add checks covering the empty-reduction, one-sided-clamp, device-migration, and dtype
